This immutable registry is specifically for OpenAI Flex execution. The managed runtime requests service_tier=flex and rejects any response that reports a different tier. The scalar schema records uncached input and output prices; cached-input provenance is retained in pricing_source because the schema has no separate cache rate field.
pricing_source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-astra: standard USD 10/M input, USD 50/M output, and USD 1/M cached input; OpenAI documents Flex as 50% of Standard, so this registry freezes USD 5/M input, USD 25/M output, and USD 0.50/M cached input. Above 272000 input tokens, the documented multipliers are applied to these Flex rates. Checked 2026-09-08.
